This '''[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' tended to be [[Color/Legends|light blue]] in appearance. They had hairless heads except for [[Hair/Legends|sideburns]] across their cheeks. Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] tended to be mostly white, and they had relatively flat [[Nose/Legends|noses]]. They had a large stature, approximately twice that of the average [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="ROTS VG" /> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jastus Farr]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref>
